audience: volunteer and staff coordinators who plan shifts, track training and certificates, and reward people in Rosterfy

useCases.title: Find who is on each shift of an event
useCases.text: List the events on the account. For one shift, list the people on it with their status and check-in times.

useCases.title: Find the people who hold a certificate
useCases.text: List the holders of one certificate, or of all certificates. Open one person's record to read their subscription and verification state.

useCases.title: Track training progress
useCases.text: List the training modules the account can use. For one module, list the people assigned to it with their status and progress.

useCases.title: Look up a volunteer's reward points
useCases.text: Search the users with a filter on the name attribute. Then read the reward point balance of that person.

useCases.title: Put a person on a shift
useCases.text: Read the shift status defaults of the event first. Then assign one person to a shift at the status you give. The server refuses a cancelled status or a full shift.
